text_block_list.name: Live MC
text_block_list.text:
And the center of today's Winning Live is, 
of course... none other than—!!

text_block_list.name: Live MC
text_block_list.text: FUSAICHI PAAAANDOOORAAA!!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Whew~♪ Yeah, yeah, yeaaaah! Chuwa-chuwa~!

text_block_list.name: Live MC
text_block_list.text:
"Most GⅠ wins in Japanese history! 
Captivating all who watch with her 
dazzling miracles, she is the Queen of an 
era!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Pandora! Pandora! Pandora! Pandora!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, eheheh, eheheheh~! Well, that's 
'cause I'm a genius, y'know~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(A dream I've had from time to time ever 
since I was little. Making history, 
shining brighter than anyone in the 
world—a dream of me at my absolute best.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(White butterflies dancing, a precious, 
cherished, fated dream——)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: A dreeeam!? Wait, whaaat—

The momentous first day that marked the 
beginning of our challenge in the Twinkle 
Series.
Fusaichi Pandora was feeling down.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ngyeeeeeeaaaaaaaaagh!!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
*pant, gasp*, *gag*, holy crap! Bungee 
jumping is insane! It was so insane my 
mind went completely blank!

...As for why we're playing around on such 
an important day, there's only one reason.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's go to the nature park tomorrow 
♡ Apparently they opened a bungee jump! 
There's tons of other fun stuff too~
choice_data_list: No, I have training.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I know that! But if you don't do bungee 
jumping when you actually feel hyped, 
you'll never jump for the rest of your 
life, right?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"So let's go, let's go, let's gooo! Come 
on, to liven things up! And pray for your 
future success!"
choice_data_list: No—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
If you go for me, I'll work super duper 
hard this afternoon, pleeease~~!!
And that was how it went.
choice_data_list: Remember, just the morning only!
Only for the morning, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I know, I know♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, look, it's almost time 
for the guinea pig petting session~! We 
gotta get in line!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, wait, I wanna eat that♡ Popping ice 
cream! I'll wait in line, so go buy it for 
me!

“I want to do this,” “I want that.” 
Looking back, ever since we met, her 
selfishness has been a daily occurrence—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Awww... I really wanted to ride those 
go-karts earlier.
choice_data_list:
Didn't you just say you'd pass because it 
was too crowded?

Even though you just said it was too 
crowded...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding, just kidding! Let's head 
back! We're already here, so let's ride 
it! Let's get an attraction photo taken, 
huh~~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Let's make some memories together. Pretty 
please? ♡

Going "Pretty please?♡" was an everyday 
occurrence. She hated putting in effort—a 
spoiled, selfish girl. And yet—
(Vroooom!!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'll show ya what a genius's racing sense 
looks like! So hold on tight, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, look at that go-kart go! It's 
hugging the inside and tearing up the 
track!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aha, I went and broke the all-time fastest 
record♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? We came from over there, and that way 
was no good? And since the finish line was 
around that way~

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Gotta be this way!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ah, found the goal~♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Fastest record in history for the giant 
maze too ♡ Aha, guess I really am a 
genius~ ♡"

"A natural genius who could handle 
anything with ease. She was that kind of 
Umamusume as well."
choice_data_list: Alright, let's get back to training!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ehh!

Fusaichi Pandora's natural genius also 
carried over into her training.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"‘Put your hands and feet on the floor, 
lower your body, and move backward’... 
Hm."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, whaddya mean? Like thisss? —Ayyy! 
Ayyy! Haha♡ That's hilarious!

She can master training routines with 
complex movements after just a single 
glance, and—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was exhausting. Plus the pool 
smelled totally like chlorine.
choice_data_list: ...How was the workload?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Felt like it was just a tiny bit 
tougher than usual? But changing up my 
breathing did the trick ♡

Even after completing a high-intensity 
workout, she looked completely unfazed. 
What's more—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"If you can pull off one serious run, you 
get a treat. All right, let's do this!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: —Taah!!
choice_data_list: (A time like this, at this stage...!)

text_block_list.text:
A blessed physique and athletic prowess. 
Her instincts and sense are second to 
none! With her, aiming for the top is well 
within reach—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Doryaaaaah!!! Pardon me, but I'll be 
taking the lead now!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~, awesome. Look, it's 
Kawakami-senpai.

I should be able to do it. Yes, if only I 
didn't have this "weakness."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: D-haah, *pant*, *gasp*!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"You alright? C'mon, let's take a break 
together!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: No, no, no, not yet!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"The princess I aim to be is still far 
ahead! One more steeep!!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Whoa, impressive.

The one dashing off was Kawakami Princess. 
A contemporary of Fusaichi Pandora, she is 
a powerful and energetic Umamusume who 
dreams of being a princess.
choice_data_list: ...Pandora, up for one more round?
...Pandora, up for one more round?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why? I did everything for today 
already, didn't I~?
choice_data_list:
Still, you've got plenty of time and 
energy left, right?

Still, you've got plenty of time and 
energy left, right?

text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series is about to begin. I 
want to push forward with training as 
greedily as possible... but still.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Nah, it's fine. I've been winning just 
fine without doing that sort of thing~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I mean, resting is important too, right~?

"Weakness"—yes. Fusaichi Pandora is an 
Umamusume who is terribly soft on herself.

To begin with, she's a natural genius who 
can master anything immediately, which 
seems to be why she doesn't really 
understand the point of putting in 
continuous effort.

"To be honest, for living a normal daily 
life, it's completely fine. However... 
when it comes to taking on the Twinkle 
Series, that's another story."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Daaaryaaaaaaahhh!!

"My rivals are all naturally gifted, and 
on top of that, every single one of them 
pours in endless effort."
choice_data_list: (I need to keep things under control.)
(I have to keep things under control.)

text_block_list.text:
Even when she has no motivation to train, 
offering rewards or praise gets her to 
tackle it gladly.
choice_data_list:
...Time to do our best with everything 
from now on!

...Let's do our best with everything from 
now on!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
? Yeah, let's do our best~. Shall we head 
home now? ♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Look, it's Craft-chan! Doing an 
interview?! So cool~♡

Looking over, Rhein Kraft—the bright and 
cheerful Umamusume currently making waves 
in the Twinkle Series—was being 
interviewed.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I have been blessed with great rivals... 
so I know rising to the top will not be 
easy."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that's precisely why I want to 
win! I want to beat everyone and claim the 
Triple Tiara!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I want to leave behind proof that I dashed 
through it all!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
To become a magnificent Tiara Umamusume... 
who can bridge the present to the future!

Rhein Kraft's passionate words reached 
clearly all the way over to where I stood.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
choice_data_list: ...Pandora?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? Ah, hahaha! You scared me!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Because—did you see that? Were you 
watching? You saw it, right? It was 
sparkling... totally glittering!
choice_data_list: Man, that was so cool.
Yeah, that was really cool.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Right?! Must be nice, I wanna sparkle too!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
If only I could run on the turf with 
sparkling eyes like that, all 
sparkly-sparkle...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
If that happens, I'm sure my dream will 
come true too... ♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Alright, deciii-ded!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "Craft-cha... No! Kuu-chan Senpai!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? P-Pandora-san!?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"You know, I decided that I'm gonna shine 
bright just like Kuu-chan-senpai!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Aaaand then, I'm gonna win a ton of GⅠs 
and shine suuuper bright~!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, do your best! Or rather, let's 
both do our best!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Let's do our best and become the most 
sparkly in the whole wide world!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! I'll do my best! Let's do our 
best together!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"So, uh... we're in the same grade, right? 
......'Senpai'?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Mm! Seeenpaaai! Mhehehe~â¡

—Fusaichi Pandora's dream is to become a 
star Umamusume who conquers numerous GⅠ 
races.

I want to run toward the pinnacle 
alongside her so that her "genius" doesn't 
go to waste...!
